name: NEED_AGGREGATION_V1
steps: normalize accepted Device Part Unit BOM to bom_key before writer lock
inside UnitOfWork re-read Device Part Unit SR/BOM and query spare_need_active_keys by exact (service_request_id,bom_key)

if no active key exists create one Spare Need with planned_quantity initialized from reviewed command intent (normally one for first contributor unless explicit batch quantity is accepted), lifecycle created event and active key
if active key exists use that Need and never create duplicate
if Device Part Unit already has active contributor relation to same Need return semantic NO_CHANGE
if it has active contributor relation to another Need reject/correct explicitly; do not silently move it
insert contributor relationship and rebuild contributor_count from active rows
never change planned_quantity because contributor_count changed
batch_rule: A reviewed batch registering N same-SR/same-BOM Device Part Units may create all units and one Need in one UnitOfWork; contributor_count=N while planned_quantity follows explicit accepted planning input, not an implicit overwrite.
separation: Same BOM on another Service Request always creates/uses a different Need aggregate.
